_comment: Gates by slice. null means ungated - an honest statement that we do not hold this slice to a number, rather than a low bar nobody checked. A slice absent from a section is ungated.
_fpr_note: AU measures 3.4% [1-17] against 29 benign cases, down from 41.4%: the three topic signals (agency mention, service-name-as-ask, 'claim' as reward) no longer fire on genuine sender mail. The gates below sit at 0.3, which is now well above where AU measures - they are a ceiling that catches drift, not a target. The target is 0.02 and AU is within interval distance of it. Tighten the AU gate once the corpus is large enough that 3.4% is not four cases' worth of noise; the remaining false positive is au-phone-1003, where every AU landline raises 'easy to spoof'.
